name: Ukukrala kwemiphunga
tagline: Umbulali ophezulu wabangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 nangaphezulu kwe-65.

urgent.heading: Kungxamisekile - bona ikliniki ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Inyumoniya kubantwana abancinci nakubantu abadala inokubulala kwiiyure nje ezimbalwa. Ukuphefumula kanzima, imilebe eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ubuthathaka obunzima - yiya esibhedlele.

Ukhohlokhohlo luvelisa umhlwa ombala womhlwa, oluhlaza, okanye onegazi

what_is_it.heading: Inyumoniya ngokwemigaqo ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Inyumoniya lusulelo lweengxowa zomoya (alveoli) kumphunga omnye okanye yomibini. Iingxowa zigcwala ulwelo okanye ubofu, nto leyo eyenza kube nzima ukuphefumla kwaye ulambe umzimba weoksijini.
paragraphs: Uninzi lwenyumoniya lubangelwa ziintsholongwane — iStreptococcus pneumoniae yeyona ixhaphakileyo. Iintsholongwane kunye nomngundo nazo zinokubangela. Usulelo luhlala lulandela umkhuhlane okanye umkhuhlane, xa amajoni omzimba ebuthathaka.

Abantu abadala abasempilweni bahlala bechacha kakuhle ngamayeza okubulala iintsholongwane okanye ukhathalelo lwenkxaso. Ingozi igxininiswe kumaqela amathathu: abantwana abangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5, abantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65, kunye nabantu abaneemeko ezingapheliyo okanye i-HIV. Kula maqela, inyumoniya lelinye lawona abulala kakhulu eMzantsi Afrika.

items.headline: Umbulali ophezulu
items.body: Inyumoniya iphakathi koonobangela abaphambili bokusweleka kubantwana eMzantsi Afrika abangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 kunye nabantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65.

items.headline: Ugonyo-luthinteleka
items.body: Isitofu sokugonya i-Pneumococcal - ikhululekile kubantwana, inconywa ngaphezu kwe-65 kunye nesifo esingapheliyo. Usika olona hlobo luqhelekileyo kakhulu.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: Inyumoniya yebhaktiriya iphendula kwii-antibiotics ngaphakathi kweentsuku. Unyango kufuneka lugqitywe ngokupheleleyo - ungaze uyeke kwangoko.

items.headline: Ngokuqhelekileyo kulandela umkhuhlane
items.body: Iinyumoniya ezininzi ziqala njengosulelo lwentsholongwane esifubeni oluba yintsholongwane. Yiyo loo nto umkhuhlane usiba mandundu emva kweentsuku ezi-5-7 ufuna uvavanyo lonyango.

pull_quote.text: Inyumoniya kumntwana omncinci inokusuka ekukhohleleni iye emandundu kwiiyure ezingama-24. Ukuba umntwana uphefumla ngokukhawuleza, wenqaba ukondla, okanye unesifuba sokutsala - musa ukulinda kusasa. Hamba ngoku.

signs.heading: Ijongeka njani inyumoniya
signs.lede: Iimpawu zenyumoniya ziqala ukuhamba kancinci-inyumoniya ukuya kumandundu kwaye abeka ubomi esichengeni. Abantwana kunye nabantu abadala bahlala bebonisa iimpawu ze-atypical.

items.title: Iimpawu zakudala
items.description: Ukhohlokhohlo (oludla ngokuba nofifi olungqindilili oluluhlaza, olutyheli, okanye olunombala womhlwa), umkhuhlane kunye nengqele, ubunzima bokuphefumla, iintlungu esifubeni ezithi zibe mandundu xa uphefumla.

items.title: Abantu abadala basenokungabinawo umkhuhlane
items.description: Abantu abadala bahlala benesiphithiphithi, ubuthathaka, ukuwa, okanye ukuwohloka kweemeko eziphantsi-ngaphandle komkhuhlane ocacileyo okanye ukukhohlela.

items.title: Abantwana
items.description: Ukuphefumla ngokukhawuleza, ukutsala isifuba (ukutsala ulusu phakathi okanye ngaphantsi kweembambo ngomphefumlo ngamnye), ukwenqaba ukutya, ukugquma, umlomo oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka - ezi zifuna ingqalelo ngokukhawuleza.

spreads.heading: Indlela inyumoniya esasazeka ngayo
yes: Ukukhohlela kunye nokuthimla okusasaza ibhaktheriya okanye iintsholongwane kubantu abosulelekileyo
Uqhagamshelwano olusondeleyo kumakhaya, ukhathalelo lwasemini, okanye kumakhaya ononophelo
Ukuphefumlelwa kokutya, isiselo, okanye isisu kwimiphunga (kubantu abadala okanye ababuthathaka)
Ukulandela olunye usulelo lokuphefumla olufana nomkhuhlane okanye i-COVID

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa umngcipheko
prevention.lede: Uninzi lwenyumoniya kubantwana abancinci, abantu abadala, kunye nabantu abagula kakhulu bayathintelwa ngamayeza okugonya, ukuhlamba izandla, kunye nokunyanga izifo zokuphefumla kwangoko.

items.title: Isitofu sokugonya ipneumococcal
items.description: Isimahla kubantwana kwiiveki ezi-6, iiveki ezili-14, kunye neenyanga ezili-9. Icetyiswa kubantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65 kunye nesifo esingapheliyo - buza eklinikhi.

items.title: Isitofu sokugonya somkhuhlane sonyaka
items.description: Umkhuhlane udla ngokukhokelela kwinyumoniya. Ukuthintela umkhuhlane kuthintela iinyumoniya ezininzi zesibini. Isimahla kumaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu.

items.title: Musa ukutshaya
items.description: Ukutshaya kuyonakalisa indlela yokuzikhusela emiphungeni kwaye ngunobangela omkhulu wenyumoniya. Ukuyeka kunciphisa umngcipheko kwiinyanga.

items.title: Ucoceko lwezandla
items.description: Hlamba izandla rhoqo, ngakumbi xa ukufutshane nabantwana abancinci, izalamane ezikhulileyo, okanye nabani na onesifo esinganyangekiyo.

items.fact: Inyumoniya inokuhlasela nakweyiphi na iminyaka. Abantwana, abantu abaselula, iimbaleki - bonke bayayifumana. Kuninzi luyanyangeka - kodwa kufuneka lunyangwe.

items.myth: Izilungiso zokukhohlela kunye nomphunga zanele ukunyanga inyumoniya.
items.fact: Inyumoniya yebhaktiriya ifuna i-antibiotics. Umphumo kunye namayeza asekhaya anokuzidambisa iimpawu kodwa akayi kulususa usulelo. Bona ugqirha.

items.myth: Ukuba ndiziva ndingcono emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, ndiyakwazi ukuyeka amayeza am amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane.
items.fact: Ukuyekisa amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane kwangoko kuvumela ezinye iibhaktheriya ukuba ziphile, zinganyangeki, kwaye zibuyise usulelo - ngamanye amaxesha mandundu. Gqibezela ikhosi epheleleyo.

items.myth: Inyumoniya isoloko ifana - yinyange kube kanye kwaye ugqibile.
items.fact: Iintsholongwane ezahlukeneyo zibanga inyumoniya ezahlukeneyo, kwaye isibulala-ntsholongwane esifanelekileyo siyahluka. Yiyo loo nto ugqirha - hayi ukuzinyanga - kufuneka akhethe unyango.

items.title: Yiya ekliniki ngalo naliphi na usulelo lwesifuba oluzingileyo
items.description: Ukhohlokhohlo olungaphucukanga emva kweentsuku ezisi-7, ingakumbi xa unomkhuhlane, iintlungu zesifuba, okanye ukuphefumla nzima, lufuna uvavanyo lukagqirha.

items.title: Ukuba ufunyanisiwe - thatha ikhosi epheleleyo ye-antibiotic
items.description: Uninzi lwenyumoniya yebhaktheriya iphathwa ngeentsuku ezi-5-7 ze-antibiotics. Thatha yonke idosi nokuba uziva ngcono - ukuyeka kwangoko kunokuvumela usulelo ukuba luphinde lubekho.

items.title: Phumla ngokupheleleyo de uchache
items.description: Inyumoniya iwugqiba umzimba. Cwangcisa ubuncinci iveki ungekho emsebenzini okanye esikolweni. Ukuqhubela phambili ukulibaziseka ukuchacha kunye nomngcipheko weengxaki.

items.title: Jonga iimpawu ezinobungozi
items.description: Ukuphefumla ngokukhawuleza okanye okusebenzayo, imilebe eluhlaza, ukudideka, intlungu yesifuba, ukungakwazi ukugcina ulwelo phantsi - yiya esibhedlele ngokukhawuleza.

items.title: Fumana izitofu zokugonya emva kokuchacha
items.description: Wakuba uchache, buza ikliniki yakho malunga nezitofu zokugonya ipneumococcal kunye nomkhuhlane ukuba awuzange ube nazo. Ikhusela isiqendu esilandelayo.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Inyumoniya ethambileyo inokunyangwa ekhaya ngamayeza okubulala iintsholongwane avela ekliniki. Inyumoniya emandla yimeko engxamisekileyo esibhedlele.
